Title: Phase 1 go-live anchored to end of November 2026
Detail: Confirmed on both sides. Supersedes the earlier early-November back-plan. All timeline slides now key off this date.

Title: Delegated approval path is off — standard individual onboarding starts now
Detail: With only 34 partner staff, the delegated agreement is not worth the wait. Individual onboarding begins immediately.

Title: Two-week sprint cadence for phase 1
Detail: Chosen over three weeks so there are two full review points before go-live.

Title: Steering deck rebuilt as a lean four-slide pack
Detail: Title, Focus, Workstream Overview, Two-Sprint Timeline. The old week-by-week slide and the appendix were dropped rather than extended.

Title: Workflow design sessions split into pre-launch and post-launch groups
Detail: Group 1 covers pre-launch design, Group 2 covers post-launch. Both run weekly.

Title: The consolidated project plan is the canonical source for milestones
Detail: The older tracker is archived. Any milestone question resolves against the consolidated plan.

Title: Program renamed from "Revenue Systems" to "Platform Consolidation"
Detail: Clarified at steering. The old name understated the scope. All decks updated.

Title: Cutover treated as a named deliverable with an owner
Detail: Previously tracked as an event with no owner, which is how it kept slipping.
